findings.highlight: Time began to move once again
findings.evidenceJa: 時間が、ほんの少し戻ってしまってる
findings.explanation: Haruki feels that time has slipped backward a little as he regresses to the abandonment accusation he had just suppressed. The translation says time begins moving again, reversing backward regression into resumed forward motion.

時間が、ほんの少し戻ってしまってる。
